metadata.case_name: CHAN MEI HING AND ANOTHER v. LAM KOK HENG

plaintiff.occupation_before: English teacher, Panel Head (GM graduate master teacher grade) at Shatin Tsung Tsinn Secondary School
plaintiff.occupation_after: Part-time teacher (from 1 September 2003 with 60% reduction; resumed full-time 12 January 2004 briefly; part-time from 1 September 2005 with 70% reduction)
plaintiff.education_level: Degree in Political Science (University of Saskatchewan)

injuries.description: posterior left sided annular tear of the circumferential type with associated disc bugle at L5-S1 level.
source: it was found that there was a posterior left sided annular tear of the circumferential type with associated disc bugle at L5-S1 level.
the annular tear of L5/S1 as revealed in the discogram was caused by the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Certain specified injuries of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: contusion injury to both of her knees
source: sustained contusion injury to both of her knees in the accident
suffered from a contusion injury to her knee and back.

manifestations.description: Pain radiating to left lower limb / left sciatica with numbness
Reduced walking tolerance (walking tolerance noted around 20-30 minutes; later able to walk for 30 minutes after physiotherapy)
Range of movements of back moderately decreased
Lower limb strength mildly decreased in general
Positive non-organic signs (Waddell's signs) indicating symptom magnification/exaggeration

treatments_received: Admission and rehabilitation at Tai Po Hospital (14 days)
Psychological treatment at Pain Management Centre (Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital)
treatments_future: Occasional outpatient neurosurgery follow-up (noted to attend about once a year)
